Say: You already know. But I also have a question. What are you?' V smiles, implies Caul already knows identity but does not explicitly confirm lineage or offer proof, asks her nature. Caul responds with suspicions rather than certain recognition, rises and deliberately reveals elongated fangs, identifies herself as vampire since before Convergence and says she swore allegiance to sovereign of Silver Court and preserved his legacy. This is voluntary direct disclosure consistent with fixed former sworn subordinate aristocrat/vampire, not automatic identification of V as Sovereign's child, admission of modern crimes, proof of father's fate or surrender. No magical Charm or attack; Cirren/Fenar/Mara observe revelation, remain alert and do not initiate force merely from species. Caul asks whether V remembers her sovereign, a genuine question rather than proof. V chooses response. Day334~18:32, no rolls, movement by V, resource use, expense or title change.
